overview: The Medford School Committee approved collective bargaining agreements for security monitors and school administrators, accepted two donations, and reviewed updates on special education and bullying prevention. Following committee questions regarding data presentation, the committee tabled the remaining agenda items, including the high school culture and climate survey report.

items.title: Ratification of Collective Bargaining Agreements
items.summary: Approved ratified collective bargaining contracts for both the district's security monitors and school administrators.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved bills, payrolls, and the regular meeting minutes from September 18, 2023.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates and Comments
items.summary: Superintendent Marice Edouard-Vincent delivered district updates, recognizing Breast Cancer Awareness Month, memorializing former educator Charlie Lyons, and sharing athletic and community announcements.

items.title: Italian Consulate Donation Acceptance
items.summary: Approved the acceptance of a grant donation of 4,493 euros from the Italian Consulate to support the world language department's Italian program.

items.title: Private Office Furniture Donation Acceptance
items.summary: Approved an anonymous private donation of office furniture and appliances valued in excess of $14,000.

items.title: Special Education Parent Advisory Council Annual Report
items.summary: Referred CPAC's recommendations on disability awareness curriculum, adaptive health, and the Thrive Act to subcommittee following their annual presentation and community awards.

items.title: Bullying Prevention and Intervention Plan Update
items.summary: Director of Student Services Joan Bowen reviewed the implementation timeline, staff training, reporting procedures, and upcoming parent workshops for the revised bullying prevention plan.

items.title: Medford High School Culture and Climate Survey Report
items.summary: Tabled the Medford High School Culture and Climate Survey report and all remaining agenda items to the next meeting following discussion over how survey response data was categorized and interpreted.
